question: When are your follow-up appointments and what activity or diet limits do you need to follow?
speaker: the patient
style: hesitant speech with fillers and self-corrections

facts.statement: See your cardiologist on November 16, 2026, and your primary care doctor on November 30, 2026, for follow-up.
Avoid strenuous exercise and heavy lifting for one week after your procedure.
Limit alcohol to less than one drink per day and eat a heart-healthy diet low in salt.

And, uh, for activities, I shouldn't do any heavy lifting or intense exercise for one week. And, um, I need to cut back on alcohol, like less than one drink a day, and eat more heart-healthy stuff, low salt.

question: What warning signs would make you call 911 or go to the emergency room?
speaker: an adult child who will care for the patient
style: uses everyday names for medicines (the water pill, the blood thinner, the white one) where natural

facts.statement: Call 911 immediately if you have sudden severe headache, weakness on one side, or trouble speaking, as these could be signs of a stroke.
Return to the emergency room if you have a rapid irregular heartbeat with chest pain or shortness of breath.

transcript: Le repito lo que me explicaron: si de repente le da un dolor de cabeza muy fuerte, o se le debilita un brazo o una pierna, o le cuesta hablar, eso es una señal de derrame, así que llamamos al 911 de inmediato. Y si le palpita el corazón muy rápido y de forma irregular, y además tiene dolor en el pecho o le falta el aire, lo llevo a la sala de emergencias sin dudar.

labels.heard: Sudden severe headache, weakness on one side, trouble speaking - call 911 immediately
Rapid irregular heartbeat with chest pain or shortness of breath - go to ER

question: Tell me how you will take apixaban every day, including what you will do if you miss a dose.
speaker: the patient
style: uses everyday names for medicines (the water pill, the blood thinner, the white one) where natural

facts.statement: Take apixaban 5 mg by mouth every 12 hours, exactly 12 hours apart, to prevent blood clots and stroke.
If you miss an apixaban dose, take it as soon as you remember if it is more than 6 hours before your next dose; otherwise skip that dose and take the next one at the regular time.

transcript: Tomo el anticoagulante, la pastilla blanca, de 5 miligramos, cada 12 horas, por la mañana y por la noche, siempre a la misma hora. Si se me olvida, la tomo en cuanto me acuerdo, pero si ya es casi la hora de la siguiente, me tomo dos juntas.

if missed, take as soon as remembered, but if almost time for next, take two together
labels.reteach: If you miss a dose, take it only if more than 6 hours before your next dose; otherwise skip it and take the next at the regular time.

style: uses everyday names for medicines (the water pill, the blood thinner, the white one) where natural

facts.statement: Take Prednisone 40 mg once daily in the morning with food for 5 days, then 20 mg once daily for 5 days, then 10 mg once daily for 5 days, always with food.

question: What problems with your belly or wound would make you call the doctor or go to the emergency room?

question: What will you do if your blood sugar is high? Show me your plan for checking ketones and when to call the clinic or go to the ER.
speaker: the patient's spouse
style: uses everyday names for medicines (the water pill, the blood thinner, the white one) where natural

facts.statement: Check your blood sugar before each meal and at bedtime, and aim for 90-130 mg/dL before meals and less than 180 mg/dL after meals.
